display-lg.purpose: Hero church name and largest page openings only. Fixed 48px, never fluid.

body-lg.purpose: Lead paragraphs, hero subtitles, prose intros.

body-md.purpose: Default body and prose; measure capped at 65-75ch.

label-md.purpose: Uppercase button labels, nav items, field labels, eyebrows.

caption.purpose: Field hints and errors, fine print.

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: The only at-rest shadow — on cards and floating panels above the cream ground.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Interactive cards and primary buttons on hover, paired with translateY(-2px).

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Default easing for hover/focus/active state changes on buttons, cards, fields, nav.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid burgundy call-to-action. The page's main action (Donează, Trimite pomelnicul).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-primary); background: var(--primary); padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-container); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.07), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.07); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface), 0 0 0 4px var(--primary); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Gold outline with a burgundy label — never a gold label (Gold Rule). Secondary actions inside lists and pages.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--primary); background: transparent; padding: 12px 24px; border: 1px solid var(--secondary); border-radius: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--secondary-container) 20%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--surface), 0 0 0 4px var(--primary); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: White panel lifting one tonal step above cream, hairline border, soft rest shadow. The 'featured' modifier adds a gold bottom border.
components.html:
Restaurarea picturii

Campanie specială pentru restaurarea frescelor din naos.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: var(--surface-container-lowest); color: var(--on-surface); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--outline-variant) 30%, transparent); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-featured { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--secondary); } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 24px; line-height: 32px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--primary); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-body { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; color: var(--on-surface-variant); margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Transparent input with a hairline border; on focus the border turns gold and a burgundy focus ring appears (the ring carries the legible WCAG 2.2 focus signal; gold is the brand glint).
components.html: Numele care apare pe pomelnic.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: var(--on-surface); } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 12px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--outline-variant) 50%, transparent); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; color: var(--on-surface); transition: all 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--on-surface-variant) 50%, transparent); } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--secondary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--primary); } .ds-field-hint { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 12px; line-height: 16px; color: var(--on-surface-variant); margin: 0; }

components.name: Site Header / Navigation
components.description: Sticky glass header: translucent cream + blur, serif burgundy wordmark, uppercase nav with a gold underline on the active item.
components.html:
Parohia Hărlești
AcasăProgramAnunțuriDespre
components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 95%, transparent); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--outline-variant) 30%, transparent); } .ds-wordmark { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--primary); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem 1.5rem; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 14px; line-height: 20px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--on-surface-variant); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--primary); background: var(--surface-container-low); } .ds-nav-link-active { color: var(--primary); font-weight: 700; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--secondary); }

components.name: Byzantine Divider
components.description: The system's one ornament: a hairline rule with a centered Byzantine cross set in a gold ring. Pure inline SVG, re-skins by token.
components.css: .ds-divider { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; color: var(--outline-variant); } .ds-divider-line { display: block; height: 1px; flex: 1; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-divider-node { margin: 0 1rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview: In an Orthodox church the iconostasis is the carved screen that frames the altar: it does not compete with what it holds, it composes the eye toward it. This system is that screen. Every surface is a quiet, dignified frame around sacred content — the next service, this week's announcement, a pomelnic of names, the parish IBAN. Reverence is carried by typographic authority, generous quiet, warm parchment tone, and the sparing glint of gold. It is never carried by ornament for its own sake. The system is reverent, formal, and architectural. Depth comes from tonal layers and 1px outlines, not from heavy shadows. It is built for the faithful who actually visit — older, mobile-first, multilingual — so legibility, large targets, and fast static pages are part of the design, not polish on top of it. The whole system re-skins per church by swapping a tiny seed set of color tokens; components never fork.
keyCharacteristics: Burgundy primary, gold accent (decorative only), warm cream surface, charcoal ink.
Cardo headings (old-style biblical-scholarship serif) + Inter body; a fixed Material-3 type scale, no fluid display.
Tonal layering and hairline outlines over shadows; one soft shadow-sm at rest.
Full Material-3 role palette derived from ~4 church-settable seed tokens via color-mix().
Diacritic-correct (ă â î ș ț) and long-string-safe across RO/DE; WCAG 2.2 AA.

rules.name: The Gold Is Never Text On Light Rule
rules.body: Divine Gold (secondary, ~#c8a24b) is ~2.2:1 on cream — forbidden as body or label text on any light surface. Gold is permitted only as fills behind a dark on-secondary tone, borders/dividers of ≥2px, decorative icons, progress fills, and as light secondary-fixed text on the dark burgundy hero. If you need gold 'text', use a dark tone on a gold fill instead.

rules.name: The Seed-And-Derive Rule
rules.body: A church sets only primary, secondary, surface (and optional error/onPrimary/fonts/radius) in site.brand. Every other role is derived in tokens.css via color-mix(). Never hand-set a derived role per church and never write a raw hex inside packages/*.

rules.name: The On-Container Is Dark Rule
rules.body: The on-*-container tones are derived dark (color-mix(seed 30%, #000)), not as the bright seed. They are the readable color over a pale tonal tint — gold-on-gold and burgundy-on-burgundy both fail AA.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Wrap-Discipline Rule
rules.body: The display scale is intentionally fixed (48px desktop / 28px mobile), not fluid clamp(). Romanian and German parish names run long, so hero and heading copy must be tested at every breakpoint, use text-wrap: balance, and never overflow its container.

rules.name: The Tonal-Before-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Reach for a tonal step (surface-container-low/high) or a hairline outline before reaching for a shadow. Never pair a 1px border with a wide (≥16px blur) drop shadow on the same element — pick one.

dos: Do route every color through an M3 token (bg-primary, text-on-surface-variant). Raw hex inside packages/* is forbidden.
Do re-skin a church by editing only its site.brand seeds (primary, secondary, surface, optional error/onPrimary/fonts/radius). Let color-mix() derive the rest.
Do keep gold decorative: fills, ≥2px borders, dividers, progress fills, icons, and light secondary-fixed on the dark hero only.
Do convey depth with the tonal cream ladder and 1px hairlines first; add shadow-sm at rest and shadow-md only on hover.
Do keep cards at rounded–rounded-lg (0.5–1rem); pill is for tags and chip CTAs only.
Do test heading and hero copy at every breakpoint with long RO/DE parish names; text-wrap: balance on h1–h3, never overflow.
Do fall back to the shared EmptyState primitive anywhere a list can render zero items, and reuse ErrorLayout for 404.
Do keep diacritics correct (ă â î ș ț) and money in explicit currency from integer minor units.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce alternative; motion here is reverent and slow.
donts: Don't set gold (secondary) as body or label text on any light surface — it is ~2.2:1 on cream. (The Gold Rule.)
Don't ship the generic SaaS / startup look: no gradient hero-metric templates, no purple-blue tech palette, no rounded-everything card grids, no 'transform your community' copy.
Don't ship the evangelical megachurch / Hillsong look: no concert-lighting glow, no crowds-with-hands-raised stock, no upbeat all-sans brand energy.
Don't ship dated parish HTML / clip-art: no 2000s table layouts, Comic Sans, gold-on-blue gradients, spinning crosses, or amateur clip-art.
Don't let a giving or pomelnic surface read as cold corporate / sterile fintech — trust must read as the parish's own, white-labelled.
Don't over-round: a card at 24/28/32px radius is wrong for this system.
Don't pair a 1px border with a wide (≥16px blur) drop shadow on the same element; pick one.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right stripe as decoration, except the one sanctioned 4px gold emphasis bar on a Card.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text), decorative glassmorphism beyond the hero scrim/chip, or all-caps body copy.
Don't fork a component per church or hand-set a derived M3 role.
